title: CWE Categories — How Weaknesses Are Classified

levels.beginner: CWE is a shared dictionary of software weaknesses. Instead of every team inventing its own names, everyone uses the same CWE numbers — CWE-79 always means the same kind of cross-site scripting weakness, wherever you read it.
levels.intermediate: CWEs are organised into views and categories (for example, improper input validation, improper access control, improper handling of sensitive data). A single CVE usually maps to one or more CWEs, which tells you the root cause class, not just the symptom.
levels.advanced: Use CWE mappings to prioritise remediation by weakness class: if ten CVEs in your stack all map to improper input validation, fixing validation centrally (a shared library, a framework feature) beats patching ten symptoms one by one. Track which CWE classes recur in your own code reviews.

key_points: One CVE can map to several CWEs; one CWE explains many CVEs.
CWE describes the weakness (root cause); CVE describes a specific instance in a product.
Categories group related CWEs so teams can spot patterns.
CWE IDs are stable references you can search in any vulnerability database.

defensive_examples.title: Looking up a weakness class in your own data
defensive_examples.code:
# In CyberMap AI, a CVE links to its CWEs through

defensive_examples.explanation: Grouping by CWE turns a long list of individual bugs into a short list of systemic problems to fix.

knowledge_check.question: What is the difference between a CVE and a CWE?
options: A CVE is a specific instance in a product; a CWE is the weakness class
A CVE is a fix and a CWE is a bug
A CWE only applies to hardware
knowledge_check.explanation: CVE-2024-12345 names one flaw in one product. CWE-79 names the whole class of cross-site scripting weaknesses that many CVEs share.

knowledge_check.question: Why group findings by CWE category instead of fixing CVEs one by one?
options: It reveals a recurring root cause you can fix once, centrally
It is required by law everywhere
knowledge_check.explanation: Ten CVEs sharing one CWE usually share one root cause. Fix the cause and the whole class shrinks.
